record.paper_title: Open problems in stochastic reinforcement models
record.original_question: In the bounded-support reinforced sequence model with essential supremum 1, mu({1})=0, and innovation probability beta, the source gives a criterion beta * integral dmu(x)/(1-x) >= 1 for existence of the mean-limit equation; if that criterion fails, mass escapes to the endpoint 1. In that failure case, can one prove a limit theorem describing the behavior around the point 1, for example under regular variation of x -> mu((1-x,1)) near x=0?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 10 In the case that (3) fails, is there a limit theorem around the point one?
This is because mass escapes at one, a condensation effect.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mu$ be a Borel probability measure on $[0,1]$ with essential supremum equal to $1$ and $\mu(\{1\})=0$, and let $\beta\in(0,1)$. Consider the reinforced sequence $(X_n)_{n\geq 1}$ defined recursively as follows: $X_1$ has distribution $\mu$, and for $n\geq 1$, conditionally on $X_1,\dots,X_n$,
$$X_{n+1}=\begin{cases}\xi_{n+1} & \text{with probability } \beta,\\ X_{K_{n+1}} & \text{with probability } 1-\beta,\end{cases}$$
where $\xi_{n+1}\sim\mu$ is independent of the past (an "innovation"), and $K_{n+1}$ is chosen uniformly at random from $\{1,\dots,n\}$ independently of $\xi_{n+1}$. Let $S_n=\frac1n\sum_{k=1}^n X_k$ denote the empirical mean.

It is known that if the criterion
$$\beta\int_{[0,1)}\frac{d\mu(x)}{1-x}\;\geq\;1\qquad(\star)$$
holds, then $S_n$ converges almost surely to a deterministic limit characterized by a mean-limit equation. If $(\star)$ fails, then mass escapes toward the endpoint $1$ (a condensation effect).

Assume $(\star)$ fails and assume moreover that the tail $x\mapsto\mu((1-x,1))$ is regularly varying at $0^+$ with some index $\alpha>0$. Establish a limit theorem describing the behavior of the empirical measure or of $S_n$ near the point $1$: identify the correct scaling sequences and limiting distribution that quantify the condensation of mass at $1$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open problem in a recent compilation arising from a MATRIX-MFO workshop on stochastic reinforcement processes; the corresponding question of a limit theorem describing condensation at the endpoint when the integrability criterion fails appears not to have been resolved in the literature.
